value_blindness: committed before any KLF12 value of any candidate reference was read; no value-derived artifact exists
reason: independent review (reports 20260925T115524Z-fe1366b7aefa and 20260925T115923Z-d132f5992c0c): implementation defects fixed in commit 07649f4, which change pinned files

changes.S5_null_calibration: the plug-in Poisson null rate is the unique root of the EXPECTED detection fraction mean(1 - exp(-rate * depth / mean depth)) over the donor's depths, not a bisection on one simulated realisation (which was not monotone in the rate); a detection fraction of 0 or 1 cannot be calibrated and S5 fails. This implements the rule as frozen ('calibrated to its detection fraction'); the S5 acceptance rule ratified in amendment 03 is unchanged
changes.fit_robustness: the Phase-1B mixture fit is run with exp() saturating to +inf, so a report-only crossing far outside the data cannot crash a converged fit; every non-overflowing value is identical to the frozen fitter's. A genuine failure to fit still counts against the observed separation
changes.T2: an unknown cAMP or XAV939 status is 'unresolved_cocktail_metadata' and never qualifies; T2 needs the missing component recorded as missing (owner D1)
changes.per_cell_input: a KLF12 count above its cell's depth (relative tolerance 1e-9) is refused

BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION: derive() qualifies but a requirement needs an owner decision not yet taken (owner acceptance under RR12, or activation of config/personalization.yaml)
